messages:
Priya S: Heads-up 10am PT interview loop next Tue for international candidate Arun Patel. He's flying in same day and needs visa-entry letter + pickup at airport. Also requested a Hindi/English interpreter for the loop and a quiet room for jetlag breaks. Can we coordinate logistics?

Mei L: I can do the visa/letter. Need Arun's passport name and flight details by EOD Fri. I can fast-track with security for the visitor badge.

Facilities: We can reserve Quiet Room C and arrange an airport shuttle pick-up. For shuttle need flight arrival time and phone number. How long is he staying?

Priya S: Arun arrives 07:40am local, will be at office ~9:30am if customs is quick. Staying one night. Phone: +44-7700-900123. I'll DM passport name.

IT Support: Do you want a loaner or will he use his laptop? If loaner, we can stage a MacBook with VPN + SSO. Also we can pre-create a temporary badge.

Priya S: He prefers to use his laptop. Please make sure guest Wi-Fi and VPN instructions are ready at the lobby. Also request that interviewers enable captions in Zoom.

Jeremy K: I can book the interpreter. Do we want simultaneous voice translation or an in-person interpreter? Budget prefers remote simultaneous interpretation. I'll arrange a remote interpreter from Intl-Translator.

Intl-Translator: Available. We'll provide Hindi<>English simultaneous audio channel and a short pre-call to sync on tech. Cost estimate sent in DM. Need candidate phone and timezone confirmation.

Mei L: Visa letter draft ready. Sending to Priya for sign-off before I email Arun.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: international travel reimbursements require receipts and exchange-rate notes. Policy link: https://intranet.redwood/policy/travel. Expense code HIRE-INTL.

Priya S: Thanks. Also request a light breakfast (fruit, GF options) and coffee in the lobby at 9:15. Emily usually handles catering but tagging here FYI.

Facilities: Shuttle confirmed for 8:00am pickup. Quiet Room C reserved 9:30am-12:30pm. Lobby welcome folder printed with VPN steps and map.

IT Support: Guest Wi-Fi voucher printed and in lobby folder. VPN instructions added to the folder and to the calendar invite.

Jeremy K: Interpreter booked for 9:15-12:30 PT, pre-call scheduled 8:30am to test audio routing. Will add Zoom interpretation channel and brief interviewers on etiquette.

Priya S: Perfect. I've updated invites to include interpretation link and asked interviewers to turn on live captions. I'll DM Arun the arrival instructions and shuttle confirmation.

Mei L: Visa letter emailed. Arun replied with thanks and confirmed passport name matches booking.

people-ops-bot: Background check: cleared. Badge pre-provision OK if passport copy received 24h prior.

Priya S: All set 1 huge thanks team. Please flag if anything changes.
